title: Clo 2024.2 New Ui Tour
description:
Join CLO Academy's Jim Simon on a quick tour of CLO's new 2024.2 UI! 

Explore CLO 2024.2's new features: https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features
Learn CLO the right way on CLO Academy: https://www.cloacademy.online/catalog

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

--- 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/itsclo3d 
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/clo-virtual-fashion-inc-/ 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/clo3d/
transcript: Hello everyone. Since CLO version 2024.2 is now available, I thought we'd take a little time and look at the updates to the UI just so that we can all be on the same page. The toggle menus have been organized and each section now has its own designation to describe what is coming underneath. Overall, the icons for the tools and in the tabs and such have been updated with more contrast to make things easier to see. All the tool icons are in the same place. And though visually things are changing, CLO's core tools and functions are all completely the same. Let's go back. Here is the version 7 workspace. Note the menus. The drop down area here. And this left sidebar. In the sidebar, at this point, there are two modular libraries. The original modular library was paired with modular from the drop down here for creating modular blocks. The new modular library combines these two processes. In 2024 here, the original modular library is removed, as is the modular from the drop down here. From the drop down menu here. Version 7.3 introduced the editor menu, which contained these options. Further reducing the modes available here in the drop down menu. In the drop down menu here, you can see that the menus are very similar to those in CLO versions 5 and 6. At this point, the menus are very similar to those in CLO versions 5 and 6. In version 2024, the menus have been reorganized. Note where some things are now. The 2D menu not only includes parametric pattern here, the sewing menu has been removed, and sewing is now here at the bottom of the 2D menu. The production menu has now been added, removing the editor menu. And this houses colorway, bill of materials, and the grading review. Connect and Closet are no longer in the menu bar in the upper right hand side, but have their own menus. The display and preferences menus have been removed, and those options are now part of the settings menu here. Plugins now have their own menu. This is helpful because of the new Unreal plugin that is currently available. We have also added our AI chat bot to the help menu to make things easier for you so that you can get help. The upper right hand corner is now simpler. With only five items left in the mode drop down, and at the moment, only your username is next to it. Click on the button to open it. The biggest visual change is the introduction of our new library. Currently, this is something that is in beta, and you can try it out. When you open version 2024 for the first time, the original library is there. But note what you have at the bottom left hand corner. You can switch to the new library. When you click it, this window opens, and you can choose learn more. This will send you to our online manual, so you can learn more about how to use this library. Once you proceed into the new library, note the icon that is now added into your upper right hand corner. You can click this to show and hide it, or you can still use the Y key, to show and hide the library. In the home area, you have all the Clo installed assets, just like the original library. You can change the view options as always, and you can see the texture of things, or previews of other options, if you turn on this little eye dot here. Under the command bar, under the community assets, is everything available at the connect marketplace. Your personal items that you have already purchased, are located here when you click this button at the bottom left. To the right of the library search, you have the account information, and this little icon here is a link to send you to the connect marketplace. Online, in your browser. This plus icon allows you to create your own libraries. This is like adding multiple folders in the original library. But now this plus sign allows you to create individual tabs for different libraries. We encourage you to fully explore the new library, but if you prefer, you can go back to the original library, by clicking this icon in the lower left hand corner of the new library window. We hope you'll love our new user interface as much as we do. Thank you.
markdown_content: ## Overview of CLO 2024.2 UI Updates This section covers the key updates and reorganizations in the user interface (UI) of CLO version 2024.2, including changes to menus, icons, and workspace layout. It highlights improvements in visual contrast, menu restructuring, and new features such as the AI chatbot and Unreal plugin integration. CLO 2024.2 introduces a more organized and visually distinct UI while retaining all core tools and functions. Tool icons remain in familiar locations but have been updated with higher contrast for better visibility. The toggle menus have been grouped under clear designations, improving navigation and reducing clutter. The workspace follows a similar structure to previous versions, such as 7.3 and earlier CLO 5 and 6 releases, but with key menu consolidations and additions. ## Menu Reorganization and Workspace Changes This section details the restructuring of menus, the removal and consolidation of certain menus, and the introduction of new menu categories in CLO 2024.2. - The **2D menu** now includes parametric pattern options and has absorbed the sewing functions, as the separate **Sewing menu** has been removed. - A new **Production menu** replaces the previous Editor menu and includes features like colorway management, bill of materials, and grading review. - **Connect** and **Closet** are no longer part of the upper right menu bar; instead, they have dedicated menus in the interface. - The **Display** and **Preferences** menus have been removed, with their options merged into a unified **Settings menu**. - Plugins have their own dedicated menu, facilitating easier access, especially for the new Unreal plugin integration. - An AI chatbot has been added to the **Help menu** to provide quick assistance within the software. - The upper right corner of the interface has been simplified to display only the mode dropdown (with five modes) and the username. ## Changes to Modular Libraries This section explains the changes to the modular libraries, focusing on the unification and removal of previous libraries to streamline modular block creation. - The original modular library and the modular library accessible via the dropdown menu have been combined into a single **new modular library**. - The original modular library and its dropdown counterpart have been removed in the 2024 version. - This consolidation simplifies the process of creating modular blocks by centralizing related tools. ## Introduction and Features of the New Library (Beta) This section introduces the new library system in CLO 2024.2, currently in beta, and explains its features, navigation, and integration with existing assets and online resources. - Upon first launching version 2024, users see the original library by default but can switch to the **new library** using an icon in the lower left of the library window. - The new library window includes a “Learn More” option that links to the online manual for detailed usage instructions. - An icon appears in the upper right corner of the interface when using the new library, which can be toggled on or off by clicking or pressing the Y key. - The **Home area** in the new library displays all CLO-installed assets similar to the original library, with view options such as texture previews and alternative previews available by toggling an eye icon. - Below the command bar, **Community Assets** show all available items from the Connect marketplace. - Users’ purchased personal items are accessible via a button at the bottom left of the library window. - Account information and a direct link to the Connect marketplace online are available next to the library search bar. - A plus icon enables users to create multiple custom libraries as individual tabs, similar to creating folders in the original library but allowing better organization through tabs. - Users can switch back to the original library at any time by clicking an icon in the lower-left corner of the new library window. ## Summary CLO 2024.2 offers a refined UI experience focused on clearer organization, enhanced accessibility, and integration of new features like the Unreal plugin and AI chatbot. The modular library system has been streamlined for efficiency, and a new library beta introduces improved asset management with customizable libraries and marketplace connectivity. These updates aim to maintain familiarity while improving workflow and user experience.
